summary: Layout for gf180-temp-por: the assembled top cell layout/cells/temp_por_top.gds (bound by hash; the same hash T1 items 3, 4 and 11 pin) plus the other cell layouts layout/cells/bias_core.gds, layout/cells/por_comparator.gds, layout/cells/por_comparator_bias_okb_inv.gds, layout/cells/por_output_chain.gds, layout/cells/temp_core.gds. Reproducibility gate: python3 layout/build_cells.py --check. This asserts the layout artifact exists and is the one the DRC, LVS and supply-ERC reports describe; it does not assert that the layout meets the area budget.
